hopDistances[v] = cost[v] <= limit ? uint(cost[v]) : NONE, where cost is the unit-weight search cost, limit = min(hops, maximumHops) and NONE = 0xffffffff. NaN and +Infinity costs compare false and stay outside the ego network.

Per edge sample at fraction t along u->v and per pixel within the buffer radius: cost = abs(sourceCost + t*weight + walk*pixelDistance); each pixel keeps the minimum cost over all samples (min mode; atomic minimum on order-preserving f32 bits, so the result does not depend on thread order).
